Container.Name: pocketwatch
Container.Overview: Minimal self-hosted time tracking for freelancers. Start and stop a timer, edit entries, filter by client or period, and export a PDF report or CSV. Data lives in two JSON files in the mounted appdata folder - no database, no account, no telemetry, no outbound requests. The API has no authentication, so keep the container on your LAN or behind a reverse proxy that handles auth.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: time tracking timesheet freelance invoice timer stopwatch
Container.Changes:
### 1.1.0 Data safety - The app does not write the time entries if it cannot read them first. Before, a failed read showed an empty history, and the next change replaced all entries. - The app shows a message if it cannot save. Before, the message was only in the browser console. - The API accepts a list of entries only. It refuses other data. - The upload limit is larger. Before, saving stopped at approximately 6000 entries. - The JSON files contain accented characters. They no longer contain escape sequences.
Export - The dialog has a new period option: Standard filters. Select All, Day, Week, Month or Year, and step to an earlier or a later period. - The dialog keeps the same height when you change the period option.
Interface - The calendar marks the full week when the period is Week. - On a phone, the Edit dialog shows the client and the activity above the start and the end times. - On a phone, the activity field is smaller. - Buttons with long text no longer cut the text on a narrow screen. - The week total in the header and its setting are removed.
### 1.0.1 - Corrected logo artwork
### 1.0.0 - Initial release
